signal: Dealerslink released its 2026 AI Suite (AI Descriptions and AI Assistant) following 2025 launches like AI Stocking, expanding its inventory platform for auto dealers

email.body1:
Matthew, saw Dealerslink shipped the 2026 AI Suite after last year's AI Stocking launch.

A product wave like that usually surfaces more in-market dealer accounts than a regional team can cover, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your region off Dealerslink's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up on your region.

New products usually raise the territory quota faster than headcount can follow. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for your region.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dealerslink's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Working a territory through a product launch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I'll tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
